# Resume Booster

> AI-powered resume optimization with recruiter-trained feedback. Free ATS scan plus paid deep-dive packages that rewrite resumes, generate cover letters, and prep candidates for interviews.

Resume Booster scans resumes against ATS (Applicant Tracking System) rules and recruiter heuristics, returning a score, missing keywords, red flags, and recommended fixes. Free scans run instantly; paid products ($1–$25) deliver tailored resume rewrites, cover letters, interview prep, and career-path simulations.
